summary: Tested STR Booking Analytics backend + frontend end-to-end. 10/10 pytest backend tests pass (all 11 sources, preview alias detection, full classification matrix, confirm+upsert, list/filter, override, imports log sorted desc, analytics summary with split, properties CRUD incl 409 duplicate + 404 delete). Frontend flows all verified: Dashboard KPIs/charts, Import upload+preview+confirm+redirect, Reservations table with classified badges + source filter + sort arrows, Properties, History list.

issues: Initial render briefly logs Recharts width(-1) height(-1) warnings before container sizes; transient, no functional impact
Source filter Select trigger lacks data-testid='source-filter' (only 'All sources' visible button); add data-testid for robust automation

action_items: (Optional) add data-testid attributes on Source filter trigger, sortable column headers, override pencil button, confirm-import button to ease future automated testing
(Optional) suppress Recharts warnings by setting explicit minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer
critical_code_review_comments: classify_source: 'website' keyword falls under Direct — Website AFTER OTA checks, correctly preventing 'booking.com' false positives — good ordering.
import_confirm uses $setOnInsert for upsert by reservation_id — append-safe. However, this means re-imports never UPDATE existing rows (intentional per spec).
override endpoint correctly validates against SOURCE_CATEGORIES and returns 400 for invalid values.
Properties duplicate check is case-sensitive on trimmed name; consider case-insensitive uniqueness if needed.
server.py is 549 lines — still within reasonable size for stage 1; consider splitting into routers/services if it grows.
